attributes.action: Close school during red temperature warnings
attributes.background: Whenever we get an extreme red weather warning schools should be closed for the duration of the warning whether they are primary or secondary schools. Most secondary schools don't have air conditioning and/or enough fans to accomodate the students needs.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
